name: Bush & Campbell
description: Accounting and advisory firm at 30 Blake Street in central Wagga Wagga. The practice lists taxation and accounting, business advisory services, succession planning, CFO services, financial planning, audit and assurance, and self managed superannuation. Alongside the Wagga Wagga office the firm also has offices at Lockhart, Tumbarumba and Tumut.
highlights: Taxation and accounting for individuals and businesses
Also has Lockhart, Tumbarumba and Tumut offices

name: WDF Accounting + Advisory
description: Accounting and advisory practice at 135-137 Peter Street, Wagga Wagga. Service lines listed on their site are tax and compliance, business advisory, superannuation, smart accounting, bookkeeping and payroll, and an HR partner service. The office is open weekdays from 8:30am to 5:00pm.
highlights: Tax and compliance work for businesses and individuals

name: Farrell Lusher Solicitors
description: Law firm at 39 Fitzmaurice Street that has practised in Wagga Wagga since 1910. Areas of work listed are family law including divorce, property settlements and parenting orders, criminal and driving matters, wills and estates, conveyancing, personal injury litigation and commercial law. Reception is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm.
highlights: Family law, divorce and parenting matters
Criminal law, AVOs and driving offences
Wills, probate and powers of attorney

name: Tankard's Law
description: Criminal and traffic law practice in Shop 6 at 54 Fitzmaurice Street, Wagga Wagga. The firm's listed work covers drug offences, assaults, break and enter, fraud and firearms matters on the criminal side, and drink driving, drug driving, speeding, dangerous driving, licence appeals and heavy vehicle offences on the traffic side.
highlights: Fitzmaurice Street office in the CBD

name: Bower Wood Lawyers
description: Law firm at 57 Gurwood Street, Wagga Wagga, with a second office at 54 The Parade, Tumbarumba. The practice works in business and commercial law, conveyancing and property development, and estate planning and administration.

name: Fitzpatricks Real Estate
description: Real estate agency on Baylis Street in the Wagga Wagga CBD. The agency handles residential sales and rentals, commercial property, property management, rural property and land sales, and offers free property appraisals along with maintenance request and e-alert services for owners and tenants.
highlights: Property management with online maintenance requests

name: Kitson Property
description: Wagga Wagga real estate agency at 66 Baylis Street handling sales, leasing and property management. The agency provides sales appraisals, investment advice, tenant forms and an online maintenance request system for renters.

name: Ray White Wagga Wagga
description: Real estate office at 83 Morgan Street covering residential, land, commercial and rural sales plus rentals and property management. The office states it has been part of the Wagga real estate industry for over 30 years and also operates offices at Junee and Coolamon. Free in-person and desktop appraisals are offered.
highlights: Also operates Junee and Coolamon offices

name: Paper Plane Finance
description: Mortgage broking business listed on Baylis Street, Wagga Wagga. The broker works across home loans, investment loans and refinancing, assisting first home buyers, repeat purchasers and property investors.

name: Angry Ant Web Design
description: Web and design studio with offices in Wagga Wagga and the Shoalhaven. Services listed are web design, branding, graphic design and social media, with client work described across government, tourism, medical, hospitality, festival and agricultural sectors.
highlights: Offices in Wagga Wagga and the Shoalhaven

name: Quickprint Wagga
description: Printing business on Fitzmaurice Street covering business stationery, promotional items, design, event and wedding printing, signage and labels. The shop trades weekdays from 8:30am to 4:30pm and is closed on weekends.

name: Khan Signs
description: Locally owned signage business on Pearson Street that describes servicing Wagga and Australia for over 30 years. Work covers vehicle signage and wraps, fleet branding, illuminated and 3D lettering, shopfront and reception signage, safety and wayfinding signs, large format and digital printing, laser cutting and engraving, and paint protection film. The business is a 3M Select partner.

name: Best St. Dental
description: Dental practice at 122 Best Street offering family and preventive dentistry, cosmetic and smile design work, orthodontics, dental implants, root canal treatment, periodontal treatment and hygiene, teeth whitening, sleep apnoea and snoring treatment, and emergency appointments. The practice offers CEREC same-day crowns and is open weekdays from 8am to 5pm.
highlights: Dental implants and root canal treatment

name: Shumack Dental & Implants
description: Dental practice on Trail Street covering family dentistry, restorative work such as fillings, crowns, bridges, dentures and veneers, and single and full arch dental implants. The practice also lists periodontics, sleep dentistry, orthodontics, mouthguards, a mobile dentistry service and same-day emergency appointments. It opens weekdays 8am to 5pm and every second Saturday morning.
highlights: Single and full arch dental implants

name: Wagga Physiotherapy and Sports Injury Centre
description: Physiotherapy and sports injury rehabilitation practice at 45 Best Street. The centre states it has been operating for over 30 years and works alongside general practitioners, specialists, gyms and local sporting groups.
highlights: Works with GPs, specialists and sporting clubs

name: Body Dynamics Health
description: Allied health clinic on Kincaid Street combining physiotherapy with exercise physiology and dietetics. The clinic runs an onsite exercise clinic, the Beat It diabetes program and sports performance consulting.

name: Granger Chiropractic
description: Chiropractic clinic at 67 Johnston Street treating neck pain and headaches, arthritis and sports injuries, with care for families and children. Techniques listed include the Activator Method, Diversified Technique, Sacral Occipital Technique and the Thompson Technique. The practice is a member of the Australian Chiropractors Association.
highlights: Activator, Diversified, SOT and Thompson techniques

name: Lightfoot Podiatry
addressLine: Shop 6, Ground Floor, D'Hudson Arcade, 176-178 Baylis Street
description: Locally owned podiatry clinic in the D'Hudson Arcade on Baylis Street. Treatments listed are general toenail care, corns and calluses, ingrown toenail removal using the BS Brace, advice on tinea and other foot infections, and diabetic foot assessments and complications. The clinic is on the ground floor for disability access and is Department of Veterans Affairs approved. It consults Tuesdays and Wednesdays, 9am to 4pm.
highlights: General toenail, corn and callus care
Ingrown toenail treatment with BS Brace
Ground floor arcade location with disability access

name: Zacharia Naumann Optometry
description: Independent optometry practice at 210 Baylis Street. Services include comprehensive eye examinations, children's vision assessments, myopia control and orthokeratology, dry eye treatment, computer vision care and emergency eye care. The dispensary carries frames, sunglasses, contact lenses, sports eyewear, safety specs and Rodenstock DNEye biometric lenses. Late consultations run on Thursdays and the practice opens Saturday mornings.
highlights: Frames, contact lenses, sports and safety eyewear

name: Lake Road Veterinary Hospital
description: Veterinary hospital on Lake Albert Road that states it is open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Services listed include consultations, diagnostics, advanced medical care, rehabilitation, grooming, puppy preschool, wildlife care and referral support for other veterinary practices.
highlights: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year

name: Kooringal Vet Hospital
description: Veterinary hospital at 2 Kimberley Drive, Tatton. Healthcare services include vaccinations, health checks, microchipping, radiography, ultrasonography and parasite control, while surgical work covers dental, desexing, ophthalmology, orthopaedic, soft tissue and emergency procedures. The clinic also offers behavioural advice, grooming, nutrition guidance, puppy preschool and rabbit and reptile care, and lists a 24 hour emergency service.
highlights: Dental, orthopaedic and soft tissue surgery

name: Michael O'Reilly Pharmacy
description: Pharmacy at 67 Baylis Street in the Wagga Wagga CBD. Services listed are PBS, concession and DVA dispensing, vaccinations including flu, whooping cough, MMR and COVID-19, sleep apnoea consultations and equipment, weekly medicines packs, MedsChecks, blood pressure and blood glucose monitoring, bowel cancer screening, baby weighing and absence from work certificates. Scripts can be uploaded online and appointments booked through the site.

name: Southcity Community Pharmacy
addressLine: Shop 5A, South City Shopping Centre, 1-7 Tanda Place
description: Pharmacy in the South City Shopping Centre on Tanda Place. The pharmacy offers Webster packing, custom compounding, online prescriptions and delivery, vaccinations, sleep apnoea support, pharmacist consultations and Farm Door frozen meals. It trades seven days, 8am to 7pm on weekdays and 9am to 5pm on weekends.

name: Lulu & Kit Haircutters
description: Fitzmaurice Street salon doing men's and women's cutting, colour work including highlights, foils, balayage, freehand placement, colour correction and toning, plus blow drying, curls, straightening and wedding and event styling. Treatments include O&M and Christophe Robin ranges, and the salon stocks Kevin Murphy, Eleven, O&M, GHD, Cloud Nine, Redken and K18. Late night trading on Thursdays.
highlights: Stocks Kevin Murphy, Eleven, O&M and K18

name: Plush Hairdressing
description: Salon at 9 Trail Street offering precision cutting, bespoke colour including lightening and toning, blow-outs and special occasion styling, bridal work, and scalp and smoothing treatments with hair and scalp analysis. Bookings are taken through Fresha and the salon sells take-home hair care products.

name: Big Barber Delux
description: Barber shop in Sturt Mall on Baylis Street, one of two Big Barber Delux shops in Wagga Wagga alongside the Marketplace store. The barbers do men's, seniors' and boys' haircuts, beard trims and styling, wet shaves and hair tattoos, and sell hair and beard care products. No appointment is needed and walk-ins are welcome.

name: BY KIRRA Skin & Beauty
description: Skin and beauty studio at 105 Forsyth Street offering facials aimed at hydration, brightening and ageing concerns, waxing and tinting, tanning, and professional makeup for special occasions, photoshoots and corporate events. Bridal makeup and gift vouchers are available, and the studio retails Medik8, iS Clinical, Vida Glow and ISSADA skincare. Appointments run Tuesday to Saturday.
highlights: Stocks Medik8, iS Clinical, Vida Glow and ISSADA
Open Tuesday to Saturday by appointment

name: Conspiracy Tattoo
description: Tattoo studio at 27 Baylis Street doing custom designs as well as pre-existing artwork. The studio describes medical grade hygiene using single-use needles and autoclave sterilisation, and is a member of the Australian Tattooists Guild.
highlights: Member of the Australian Tattooists Guild

name: Possums Early Learning Centre
description: Long day care centre at 7 Forsyth Street for children from six weeks to five years, running two rooms, Little Possums and the Preschool Room. The centre operates 8am to 6pm Monday to Friday, 52 weeks a year excluding public holidays, and families can access the Child Care Subsidy.
highlights: Long day care from six weeks to five years

name: Knights Deli
description: Delicatessen and food providore on Fitzmaurice Street selling meats and smallgoods, artisan cheeses, cured meats, antipasto, salads and pies, plus pantry lines and a house-made Knights Own range. The shop also does catering, grazing boxes, platters and gift hampers, and trades Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 4pm.

name: CBM Meats
description: Wholesale and retail butcher located at the rear of 61 Baylis Street, Wagga Wagga. The shop sells premium cuts, smallgoods and smoked meats, with a range built around Riverina Angus beef, Australian pork and Riverina lamb. It trades weekdays 9am to 6pm and weekends 9am to 3pm.
highlights: Riverina Angus beef and Riverina lamb
Behind the Victoria Hotel on Baylis Street

name: Little Triffids Flowers
description: Florist and gift shop at 30 Fitzmaurice Street selling bouquets, potted plants and a gift range that takes in jewellery, baby items, beauty products, books, stationery, food and drink, garden wares and homewares. The shop does wedding and funeral flowers and runs workshops. Open Monday 9am to 2pm, Tuesday to Friday 9am to 5pm and Saturday 9am to 2pm.

name: Kidsons Cycles
description: Bike shop at 105 Fitzmaurice Street stocking road and mountain bikes from Merida, Cervelo, Specialized, Trek and Cannondale, BMX from DK, Fit Bike Co, GT and Kink, and kids bikes. The workshop offers repairs and a range of service packages from a deluxe bike wash to roadworthy, general, premium and platinum services, plus bike fitting sessions of about an hour. New bikes come with a free first service.
highlights: Road, mountain, BMX and kids bikes
Merida, Cervelo, Specialized, Trek and Cannondale
Free first service with a new bike

name: Gateway Bookshop
description: Independent bookshop in The Piazza on Baylis Street. The range covers children's and adult fiction, non-fiction, educational resources across several levels, special edition books and teacher diaries, and the shop also runs VR escape room experiences. Open Tuesday to Friday 10am to 5pm and Saturday 10am to 1pm.

name: Diamonds on Baylis Jewellers
description: Jewellery shop at 80 Baylis Street that has traded since 1984 and handcrafts rings, chains, pendants, earrings and bracelets in 9ct and 18ct yellow, white and rose gold. Stones used include diamonds, peridot, aquamarine, morganite, ruby and topaz, and the shop carries Adina and Citizen watches. On-site services cover custom design, repairs and restoration, ring resizing, stone resetting and appraisals.
highlights: On-site repairs, resizing and stone resetting

name: Allison Music Wagga
description: Locally owned music shop at 85 Forsyth Street that says it has served Wagga Wagga and the Riverina for over 23 years. Stock covers acoustic, electric, classical and bass guitars, amplifiers, acoustic and digital drums, acoustic and digital pianos, keyboards, folk instruments such as banjo, mandolin, ukulele and harmonica, orchestral instruments, PA and recording gear, sheet music and apparel.

name: Riverina Driving Academy
description: Driving school teaching learner drivers across Wagga Wagga and district, including Ashmont, Bourkelands, Estella, Forest Hill, Glenfield Park, Gumly Gumly, Kooringal, Lake Albert, Lloyd, Mount Austin, Tatton, Tolland and Turvey Park. Lessons run 60 minutes in dual-control automatic Honda Jazz cars, with a package of five lessons plus a sixth at half price. The instructor is Keys2Drive accredited.
highlights: Five lesson package with sixth at half price
Covers Wagga suburbs and nearby villages
Pick-up across Wagga Wagga and district

name: Rapley's Nursery and Landscape Supplies
description: Nursery and landscape supply yard at 56 Cummins Road, Lake Albert. The business sells locally grown plants and advanced trees alongside soils, mulches and landscape products, and offers planting advice, planning and design assistance, soil testing and delivery through Wagga Wagga and surrounding areas. Open weekdays 8am to 5pm and weekends 8:30am to 3pm.
highlights: Locally grown plants and advanced trees

name: Storehouse Botanica
description: Florist and gift store at 1 Humphrys Street, Junee. Arrangements are offered in pastel, tonal, bright and wildflower styles, and the shop also carries home fragrance, bath and body products, books, clothing and accessories. Next business day delivery is available in Junee and surrounding areas.
highlights: Home fragrance, bath and body gifts
Next business day delivery in Junee and district

name: Monty & Moo
description: Clothing, gifts and homewares store on Albury Street, Holbrook. The range covers dresses, shirts, knitwear and jackets, accessories including belts, jewellery, handbags and footwear, plus home and garden goods, bath and beauty products, greeting cards and stationery.

name: Skinner & Associates
description: Law firm founded in 1969 with an office at 24 Balfour Street, Culcairn and a second office in Albury. Practice areas listed are commercial and corporate law, conveyancing and property law, family law, wills and estates, dispute resolution and litigation, employment law, public notary work and court and tribunal appearances.
highlights: Family law and wills and estates

name: Custom Music
description: Music store on East Street, Narrandera, one of three Custom Music stores along with Griffith and Wagga Wagga. Stock includes guitars, ukuleles, amplifiers, drums, pianos, brass and wind instruments, violins and home recording equipment, and the business sells, installs and services PA systems and lighting for schools, clubs and churches. The Narrandera store opens weekdays 10am to 5pm and Saturday 9am to noon.
highlights: Guitars, drums, pianos and orchestral instruments
Installation and service for schools, clubs and churches
Stores at Narrandera, Griffith and Wagga Wagga
